name: text-3d

frames.best_why: Hello 3D is nearly upright with its black and yellow stacked shadows fully visible.

tagline: White letters with black and yellow offset layers that tilt and wobble.
summary: The words Hello 3D are set in heavy white type with a thick black outline and two offset copies behind, one black and one yellow. The whole word gently rocks back and forth.
appearance: Large heavy white letters read Hello 3D against black. Each letter is wrapped in a thick black stroke, and two offset copies sit behind it down and to the right, the first black and the second bright yellow, so the word looks extruded in layers. The whole block is slightly rotated.
behaviour: The entire word rocks around its centre on a looping animation, tipping about five degrees left and right and settling level between swings. No pointer input is involved.
search_phrases: comic style title with drop shadow
letters that rock side to side
layered text effect with yellow shadow
use_when: A playful hero or event headline that should feel like a printed poster sticker rather than clean type.
avoid_when: The heavy stroke and stacked shadows need a large font size, and the black outline disappears against a black page.
customise: Set the text colours, stroke and shadow colours and sizes, letter spacing, animation on/off and duration via props; the wiggle keyframes are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One text node with CSS stroke, shadows and a short keyframe rotate; nothing else runs.

a11y.note: The looping wiggle has no prefers-reduced-motion check, so it keeps rocking for motion-sensitive readers.

issues: The black outline vanishes against the black demo background.
polish_why: Bold layered type that reads clearly; the black stroke disappears on the black stage.
